note: The specification gates and the staffing gate (EE-236). SAD's gate questions for 0A to 1B, asked of Naive's own records and never of SAD's documents (EE-036 stands: its surviving rules become checks). Each answer names the record type and field it is read from. A hole is a question no record type answers yet: it is reported as not built and never blocks. After 1B is reached, the human-capital lead drafts one staffing decision whose candidates are sets of proposed digital workers, and only a person's decision activates them.

gates.name: Ideas captured
gates.question: Are the founder's ideas out of their head and in the records?

questions.question: Are the founder's ideas written down?
Are the ideas sorted into one map with a root?

gates.name: Problem researched
gates.question: Is the problem researched rather than assumed?

questions.question: Is the problem stated for a named segment?
Does evidence from outside the founder back the problem?
Have the market and the alternatives been looked at?
Has the research been synthesized into findings?
questions.hole: Not built: no record type holds a research synthesis. Interviews, sources and the problem record hold the research itself, and nothing records what was concluded from all of it together.

gates.name: Vision stated
gates.question: Is the vision stated, and is the thesis under it written so it can fail?

questions.question: What end does the venture serve?
What does the venture promise?
Who is the customer?
Is the thesis registered, so it can fail?

gates.name: Version scoped
gates.question: Is the scope of this version committed?

questions.question: What does this version commit to?
How will the version be known to be done?
What must the venture not do?
Which product is in scope?

gates.name: Version specified
gates.question: Is the version specified well enough to staff?

questions.question: What does the product do?
Does every capability being built serve a goal?
What must hold, and how is each requirement verified?
How will it be built?
What does the product store, and what rules bind it?
questions.hole: Not built: no record type holds a venture's own data model, its entities and their constraints. A spec artifact may describe it in words, which this gate cannot read as a model.

questions.question: Are the decisions the specs rest on settled?

staffing.question: Would you like to begin deploying agents?

candidates.label: One worker per function the specs name, as that function's agent
The library's specialist roles for those functions, and the function's agent where none serves
